- 配方原文 [0018_Fan 等 - 2026 - Multi-Group Functional Additive Enhances the Wide-Temperature-Range Performance of Sodium-Ion Batter::sec3::child0]：The main raw materials (sodium salt, solvents, and additives), including ethylene carbonate (EC), ethyl methyl carbonate (EMC), and $NaPF_{6}$ , were supplied by Guangzhou Tinci Materials Technology Co., Ltd. TMBS was synthesized via a one-pot method combined with in situ vacuum distillation, as shown in Figure S1. The baseline electrolyte was prepared by dissolving $NaPF_{6}$ in mixed solvents of EC:EMC = 3:7 to a concentration of 1 mol $L^{-1}$ . Considering the cost and usual dosage, the concentrations of all additives were 1%. The cathode material NFM was obtained from Jiangsu Xiangying New Energy Technology Co., Ltd., and anode material HC was purchased from Kuraray Co., Ltd. Pouch cells was assembled with an NFM cathode (121 mAh $g^{-1}$ at 0.1 C), an HC anode (293 mAh $g^{-1}$ at 0.05 C), and a Celgard 2700. The NFM cathodes were prepared by the slurry with a mass ratio of 94.5:1.8:1:2.5:0.2 for NFM active material/polyvinylidene difluoride (PVDF)/carbon nanotube (CNT)/conductive carbon black (Super P)/maleic acid. The HC active material, sodium carboxymethyl cellulose (CMC), styrene–butadiene rubber (SBR), and conductive carbon black (Super P) with a mass ratio of 95:1.5:2:1.5 were mixed and dispersed in water, and then, the slurry was coated on an aluminum substrate to prepare the HC anode. The areal loadings of the NFM cathode and HC anode were 33 g $m^{-2}$ and 16 g $m^{-2}$ , respectively.

盐：NaPF6；浓度：1 mol L⁻¹；NaPF6：1 mol L⁻¹；溶剂：EC, EMC；溶剂比例（质量）：EC=3, EMC=7；添加剂：TMSBS；添加剂用量：TMSBS=1 wt%。
- 配方原文 [0031_Li 等 - 2025 - Designing an efficient all-climate carbonate-based electrolyte facilitating commercial pouch sodium-::sec4::child0]：Sodium hexafluorophosphate (NaPF $_6$ ), ethylene carbonate (EC), and methyl ethyl carbonate (EMC) were supplied by Guangzhou Tinci Materials Technology Co, Ltd. NaPF $_6$ was dissolved into a mixture of EC and EMC (EC: EMC = 3:7 in wt%) to prepare Baseline electrolyte (1 mol L $^{-1}$ ). TMSBS additive (1 wt%) was added to the Baseline electrolyte to form a functional electrolyte. NFM and HC active materials were purchased from Jiangsu Xiangying New Energy Technology Co., Ltd. and Kuraray Co., Ltd., respectively. The NFM cathode was fabricated from NFM active material, polyvinylidene difluoride (PVDF), carbon nanotubes (CNT), conductive carbon black (Super P), and maleic acid dispersed in $N$ -methylpyrrolidone (NMP) at a mass ratio of 94.5:1.8:1:2.5:0.2, and the slurry was coated onto an aluminium substrate. The HC anode contained 95% HC, 1.5% carboxymethyl cellulose (CMC), 2.0% styrene butadiene rubber (SBR), and 1.5% Super P. A Celgard 2700 membrane (Xingyuan Materials Co., Ltd) was used as the separator. The mass loading of the cathode and anode was 33.0 and 20.1 mg cm $^{-2}$ , respectively. The negative-to-positive (N/P) capacity ratio was 1.1. The empty pouch cells were dried under vacuum at 80 °C for 72 h, then transferred to a glove box, and injected 6.0 g of electrolyte. Other operations not mentioned were all carried out using the general methods in the battery manufacture.

## 候选评估
### candidate-1-tmbs
评估建议：The candidate composition (NaPF6 1 M, EC:EMC 3:7, 1% TMBS) and NFM||HC pouch format match the source, and the -10 C cycling benefit is supported. However, the program's hard requirement of no observed collector or shell corrosion is unverified, and the candidate uses a pouch format with no stainless-steel shell evidence, so a structured hold is warranted rather than a recommendation. No computation predictions were available to add further support.
任务要求与已有依据（模型语义判断，程序核验出处）：
- Electrolyte salt/solvent identity: NaPF6 at 1 mol/L in EC:EMC = 3:7：The source states the baseline electrolyte was prepared by dissolving NaPF6 in EC:EMC = 3:7 to 1 mol L-1, matching the candidate composition. [0018_Fan 等 - 2026 - Multi-Group Functional Additive Enhances the Wide-Temperature-Range Performance of Sodium-Ion Batter::sec3::child0]
- TMBS additive present at 1% in the electrolyte：The abstract states a TMBS multigroup additive is developed for the electrolyte, and the Experimental section says all additive concentrations were 1%, matching the candidate's 1 wt% TMBS. [0018_Fan 等 - 2026 - Multi-Group Functional Additive Enhances the Wide-Temperature-Range Performance of Sodium-Ion Batter::sec3::child0][0018_Fan 等 - 2026 - Multi-Group Functional Additive Enhances the Wide-Temperature-Range Performance of Sodium-Ion Batter::sec1]
- Cell format and chemistry: NFM||hard-carbon pouch cell：The abstract and Experimental section describe NFM/HC pouch cells assembled with an NFM cathode and HC anode, matching the target cell. [0018_Fan 等 - 2026 - Multi-Group Functional Additive Enhances the Wide-Temperature-Range Performance of Sodium-Ion Batter::sec3::child0][0018_Fan 等 - 2026 - Multi-Group Functional Additive Enhances the Wide-Temperature-Range Performance of Sodium-Ion Batter::sec1]
- Low-temperature (-10 C) cycling performance of the candidate electrolyte：The conclusion reports capacity retention of TMBS-containing cells after 100 cycles at -10 C increased to 90% (vs 0% for baseline), and Figure 2c reports ~90% retention after 120 cycles at lower temperature, directly supporting -10 C operation. [0018_Fan 等 - 2026 - Multi-Group Functional Additive Enhances the Wide-Temperature-Range Performance of Sodium-Ion Batter::sec8::child0][0018_Fan 等 - 2026 - Multi-Group Functional Additive Enhances the Wide-Temperature-Range Performance of Sodium-Ion Batter::sec6::child2]
- No observed corrosion of the Al current collector：The source only notes that the HC slurry was coated on an aluminum substrate; it reports no corrosion observation or test for Al, and the anti-corrosion reference cited is a general literature entry, not a result for this electrolyte/cell. [0018_Fan 等 - 2026 - Multi-Group Functional Additive Enhances the Wide-Temperature-Range Performance of Sodium-Ion Batter::sec3::child0]
- No observed corrosion of the stainless-steel shell：The work uses pouch cells and contains no statement about a stainless-steel shell or its corrosion behavior; no negative observation is reported. 
文献与候选的关联：The Experimental section (sec3::child0) establishes that the TMBS electrolyte uses NaPF6 in EC:EMC=3:7 at 1 mol/L with 1% additive and that pouch cells were assembled with an NFM cathode and HC anode on an Al substrate; the conclusions (sec8::child0) and Figure 2c (sec6::child2) then tie that same pouch NFM/HC cell configuration to the -10 C cycling result, so the composition and cell-format link is established for the low-temperature claim. This association does not extend to collector or shell corrosion, which is not measured. [0018_Fan 等 - 2026 - Multi-Group Functional Additive Enhances the Wide-Temperature-Range Performance of Sodium-Ion Batter::sec3::child0][0018_Fan 等 - 2026 - Multi-Group Functional Additive Enhances the Wide-Temperature-Range Performance of Sodium-Ion Batter::sec8::child0][0018_Fan 等 - 2026 - Multi-Group Functional Additive Enhances the Wide-Temperature-Range Performance of Sodium-Ion Batter::sec6::child2]
### candidate-2-tmsbs
评估建议：低温与目标电池构型有来源支持，但原问题要求的“未观察到集流体或壳腐蚀”缺乏直接阴性证据，故暂缓推荐并保留该空缺。
任务要求与已有依据（模型语义判断，程序核验出处）：
- Electrolyte is NaPF6 at 1 mol/L in a carbonate EC:EMC 3:7 (by wt) mixture：原文2.1节明确NaPF6溶于EC:EMC=3:7 wt%配成1 mol/L Baseline电解液，与候选的盐、浓度和溶剂比例一致。 [0031_Li 等 - 2025 - Designing an efficient all-climate carbonate-based electrolyte facilitating commercial pouch sodium-::sec4::child0]
- Contains 1 wt% TMSBS additive：原文说明在Baseline中加入1 wt% TMSBS形成功能电解液，与候选的TMSBS用量一致。 [0031_Li 等 - 2025 - Designing an efficient all-climate carbonate-based electrolyte facilitating commercial pouch sodium-::sec4::child0]
- Target cell is an NFM||hard-carbon pouch cell operable at low temperature (~-10 °C)：摘要与结果均报道含TMSBS电解液用于pouch NFM/HC电池并在-10 °C循环、-30 °C放电，适配低温和目标电池构型。 [0031_Li 等 - 2025 - Designing an efficient all-climate carbonate-based electrolyte facilitating commercial pouch sodium-::sec2::child0][0031_Li 等 - 2025 - Designing an efficient all-climate carbonate-based electrolyte facilitating commercial pouch sodium-::sec7::child9]
- No observed corrosion of the Al current collector or the stainless-steel shell：来源描述了性能、界面膜与产气抑制，但未提供该候选对各集流体或钢壳腐蚀的阴性观察，无法据此判定无腐蚀。 
文献与候选的关联：候选的NaPF6/EC:EMC/TMSBS组成与来源中制备并测试的功能电解液一致，来源以pouch NFM/HC电池进行-10 °C循环和-30 °C放电测试，可将这些结果关联到本候选；但来源未涉及Al集流体或不锈钢壳腐蚀。 [0031_Li 等 - 2025 - Designing an efficient all-climate carbonate-based electrolyte facilitating commercial pouch sodium-::sec4::child0][0031_Li 等 - 2025 - Designing an efficient all-climate carbonate-based electrolyte facilitating commercial pouch sodium-::sec7::child9]
### candidate-3-nb-dfp
评估建议：The candidate's low-temperature NFM/HC pouch performance is well supported, but the program's hard requirement of no observed Al collector or stainless-steel shell corrosion has no supporting (or any) evidence in the retrieved sources, so a recommendation cannot be justified yet and the decision is held.
任务要求与已有依据（模型语义判断，程序核验出处）：
- Electrolyte intended for an NFM||hard-carbon sodium-ion pouch cell：The source describes pouch test cells built with an NFM cathode and hard-carbon anode, and the NB (NaDFP+TMSB) electrolyte is one of the functional electrolytes applied to these NFM/HC pouch cells. [0156_Cai 等 - 2025 - A hard-soft synergy strategy enables drastic temperature performance of pouch sodium-ion batteries o::sec4::child0][0156_Cai 等 - 2025 - A hard-soft synergy strategy enables drastic temperature performance of pouch sodium-ion batteries o::sec8::child3]
- NaPF6 salt at 0.8 mol/L in an EC:EMC 3:7 solvent mixture (candidate's baseline composition)：The baseline electrolyte is explicitly prepared by dissolving NaPF6 in EC:EMC = 3:7 to 0.8 mol/L, matching the candidate's salt, concentration and solvent ratio. [0156_Cai 等 - 2025 - A hard-soft synergy strategy enables drastic temperature performance of pouch sodium-ion batteries o::sec4::child0]
- NaDFP + TMSB dual additive in roughly 1:1.5 proportioning (NB electrolyte)：The text states a 1:1.5 proportioning of NaDFP to TMSB is chosen as the most suitable ratio, and NaDFP+TMSB is designated the NB electrolyte added to the baseline. [0156_Cai 等 - 2025 - A hard-soft synergy strategy enables drastic temperature performance of pouch sodium-ion batteries o::sec8::child0][0156_Cai 等 - 2025 - A hard-soft synergy strategy enables drastic temperature performance of pouch sodium-ion batteries o::sec4::child0]
- Stable low-temperature operation at -10°C for the NW/NB electrolyte：The paper reports a high capacity retention of 92% after 350 cycles (and stable 1C cycling) at -10°C, and that NB electrolyte improves rate performance at -10°C and 1C. [0156_Cai 等 - 2025 - A hard-soft synergy strategy enables drastic temperature performance of pouch sodium-ion batteries o::sec10::child0][0156_Cai 等 - 2025 - A hard-soft synergy strategy enables drastic temperature performance of pouch sodium-ion batteries o::sec8::child3]
- The NaDFP+TMSB combination is suited to the low-temperature application：The abstract contrasts the two combinations, stating the NaDFP and TMSB combination is more suitable for low-temperature requirements due to reduced desolvation energy and viscosity. [0156_Cai 等 - 2025 - A hard-soft synergy strategy enables drastic temperature performance of pouch sodium-ion batteries o::sec2::child1]
- Al current collector present in the cell construction：Both cathode and anode slurries are described as coated on an aluminum substrate, establishing Al foil as the current collector in these pouch cells. [0156_Cai 等 - 2025 - A hard-soft synergy strategy enables drastic temperature performance of pouch sodium-ion batteries o::sec4::child0]
- Stainless-steel shell/casing compatibility：The retrieved text describes the pouch cell size and layers but never states the shell/casing material or any stainless-steel component, so no evidence bears on stainless-steel compatibility. 
- No observed Al collector or stainless-steel shell corrosion：No source reports a direct negative observation (no corrosion/leaching/deposition) for this candidate on the Al collector or a stainless-steel shell; the paper's overall good cycling does not constitute the required negative observation. 
文献与候选的关联：The NB electrolyte (NaPF6 in EC:EMC 3:7 with NaDFP+TMSB) was actually applied and electrochemically tested in NFM/hard-carbon pouch cells, including -10°C rate and cycling tests, so the low-temperature and cell-format claims are directly tied to the candidate under test. [0156_Cai 等 - 2025 - A hard-soft synergy strategy enables drastic temperature performance of pouch sodium-ion batteries o::sec8::child3][0156_Cai 等 - 2025 - A hard-soft synergy strategy enables drastic temperature performance of pouch sodium-ion batteries o::sec3::child4]
### candidate-4-nafsi-0016
评估建议：The candidate matches the requested salt/concentration/solvent and pouch NFM||HC format and shows strong -10 °C cycling, but the hard requirement of no collector or shell corrosion is refuted: additive-free NaFSI-E corrodes Al foil and especially the stainless-steel shell, and the paper only endorses NaFSI-E for low temperature after an additive fixes corrosion. Without such an additive the candidate cannot be recommended, so a hold decision is issued pending an additive that suppresses corrosion.
任务要求与已有依据（模型语义判断，程序核验出处）：
- Electrolyte is 0.8 M NaFSI dissolved in an EC:EMC = 3:7 solvent mixture：The paper states three electrolytes at 0.8 M were all prepared by dissolving the sodium salt in EC:EMC = 3:7, matching the candidate's salt, concentration and solvent ratio. [0016_Fan 等 - 2025 - Electrolyte salts for large-scale application of sodium-ion batteries NaPF6 and emerging alternativ::sec5::child0]
- Target cell is a NFM (NaNi1/3Fe1/3Mn1/3O2) cathode / hard-carbon anode pouch cell：Pouch cells were assembled with a NFM cathode and HC anode, exactly the NFM||HC pouch format requested. [0016_Fan 等 - 2025 - Electrolyte salts for large-scale application of sodium-ion batteries NaPF6 and emerging alternativ::sec5][0016_Fan 等 - 2025 - Electrolyte salts for large-scale application of sodium-ion batteries NaPF6 and emerging alternativ::sec5::child0]
- Low-temperature electrolyte performance relevant to -10 °C operation：NFM||HC pouch cells with NaFSI-E were cycled at -10 °C, 1C; NaFSI-E cells retained 90 % capacity after 200 cycles while NaPF6-E failed after 50 cycles, and the abstract reports low-temperature improvement to 85.9 %. [0016_Fan 等 - 2025 - Electrolyte salts for large-scale application of sodium-ion batteries NaPF6 and emerging alternativ::sec9::child4][0016_Fan 等 - 2025 - Electrolyte salts for large-scale application of sodium-ion batteries NaPF6 and emerging alternativ::sec3::child0]
- No observed corrosion of the Al current collector：The paper states NaFSI-E corrodes Al foil during cycling (prior research) and shows Al corrosion products on the glass fiber in coin-cell testing; the text concludes NaFSI-E would corrode Al foil as well as stainless steel, so the required absence of Al corrosion is not met. [0016_Fan 等 - 2025 - Electrolyte salts for large-scale application of sodium-ion batteries NaPF6 and emerging alternativ::sec9::child0][0016_Fan 等 - 2025 - Electrolyte salts for large-scale application of sodium-ion batteries NaPF6 and emerging alternativ::sec9::child1]
- No observed corrosion of the stainless-steel shell：For the pouch cell the Al foil remained intact but the battery shell showed obvious corrosion traces (Fig. 3g), and the authors infer NaFSI-E corrodes stainless steel (even preferentially), directly contradicting the required absence of shell corrosion. [0016_Fan 等 - 2025 - Electrolyte salts for large-scale application of sodium-ion batteries NaPF6 and emerging alternativ::sec9::child0][0016_Fan 等 - 2025 - Electrolyte salts for large-scale application of sodium-ion batteries NaPF6 and emerging alternativ::sec9]
- NaFSI without additives suffices for low-temperature application：The conclusion explicitly states NaFSI-E is suitable for low-temperature application only after solving its corrosion by an additive; this additive-free candidate therefore does not meet the corrosion constraint. [0016_Fan 等 - 2025 - Electrolyte salts for large-scale application of sodium-ion batteries NaPF6 and emerging alternativ::sec11::child0]
文献与候选的关联：The corrosion and low-temperature evidence come from the same paper's NFM||HC pouch cells and coin cells using NaFSI in EC:EMC = 3:7 at 0.8 M; the corrosion observations are made on the Al foil and on the pouch shell of these cells, so they transfer directly to the candidate's collector/shell configuration. [0016_Fan 等 - 2025 - Electrolyte salts for large-scale application of sodium-ion batteries NaPF6 and emerging alternativ::sec5][0016_Fan 等 - 2025 - Electrolyte salts for large-scale application of sodium-ion batteries NaPF6 and emerging alternativ::sec9::child0]
### candidate-5-napf6-baseline
评估建议：候选 NaPF6-E 与目标电解质的盐种/浓度/溶剂比例一致，且铝集流体与不锈钢壳体均无腐蚀迹象；但其在目标 -10 °C 下迅速失效（50 循环后 sudden death），文献将低温柔性归于 NaFSI-E（解决腐蚀后），故不推荐本候选作为该低温电芯的电解质，建议保持/转向文献支持的低温候选。
任务要求与已有依据（模型语义判断，程序核验出处）：
- Salt identity: 0.8 M NaPF6 in EC:EMC = 3:7 (matching the candidate's salt/concentration/solvent-ratio identity)：原文明确以 0.8 M 钠盐溶于 EC:EMC = 3:7 制备电解质，其中 NaPF6 对应 NaPF6-E，与候选盐种、浓度、溶剂比例一致。 [0016_Fan 等 - 2025 - Electrolyte salts for large-scale application of sodium-ion batteries NaPF6 and emerging alternativ::sec5::child0]
- Cell format: NFM||hard-carbon pouch cell：原文以 NFM 为正极、HC 为负极装配 pouch cell 并系统比较三种钠盐电解质，与目标体系一致。 [0016_Fan 等 - 2025 - Electrolyte salts for large-scale application of sodium-ion batteries NaPF6 and emerging alternativ::sec9::child1][0016_Fan 等 - 2025 - Electrolyte salts for large-scale application of sodium-ion batteries NaPF6 and emerging alternativ::sec5::child1]

A carbonate-based electrolyte containing a self-synthesized trimethylsilyl-benzenesulfonate (TMSBS) multifunctional additive is developed to enhance the all-climate performance of pouch $NaNi_{0.33}Fe_{0.33}Mn_{0.33}O_{2}$ (NFM)/hard carbon (HC) sodium-ion batteries (SIBs) over a wide range from -30 to 60 °C. Fig. 3(a) shows the capacity stabilization effect of TMSBS on the electrolyte at different rates at $-10^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$ . TMSBS electrolyte maintains stable performance under $-10^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$ cycling, while the Baseline electrolyte exhibits rapid decay (Fig. S7b). Besides, The extreme low-temperature discharge experiment at $-30^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$ (Fig. 3b) showed that the cells with TMSBS electrolyte had a capacity of 879, 853, and $814\mathrm{mAh}$ at 0.2, 0.3, and $0.5\mathrm{C}$ ( $1\mathrm{C} = 900\mathrm{mA}$ ), while the cells with Baseline electrolyte had a capacity of 801, 752, and $716\mathrm{mAh}$ , respectively (Fig. 3c). In other words, at low temperatures, TMSBS can provide higher electrolyte energy density and achieve greater capacity retention, making it suitable for emergency powering of energy storage devices in extremely cold conditions. The rate performance of SIBs at room temperature is crucial for evaluating their performance in practical applications. High-rate-performance batteries can rapidly charge and discharge in a short period of time, which is particularly important for devices that require high power output, such as electric vehicles and mobile devices [23,36].

Performance of the batteries with different electrolytes
The effect of sodium salts on the safety is also an important factor for commercial SIBs, and the corrosion of battery devices is one of the reference bases for sodium salt selection. Fig. 3e and f shows the corrosion results of Al foil in different electrolytes. As is reported at previous research, NaFSI-E would corrode Al foil during cycling so that may cause safety issues where NaDFOB-E and $\mathrm{NaPF_6 - E}$ hardly react. The coin cell was used to evaluate the corrosion of Al foil in different electrolytes. Surprisingly, although it can still observe obvious corrosion products on the glass fiber after cycling with NaFSI-E when measured with the coin cell, the Al foil inside the SIBs remains integrity, but the battery shell has obvious corrosion traces, as shown in Fig. 3g, which is quite different from the result measured by the electrolytic tank as shown in Fig. 3h. From this phenomenon, it can be inferred that NaFSI-E would corrode Al foil as well as stainless steel but corrode stainless steel first.

Battery performance is the most straightly and convincing evidence to evaluate the electrolytes with different sodium salts. At present stage, NFM and HC are widely considered as ideal cathode and anode materials for commercial pouch SIBs due to their duration to water and air $[23–26]$ . The electrochemical performance of NFM||HC pouch SIBs with various electrolytes including $NaPF_{6}$ , NaFSI and NaDFOB from $-40\ ^{\circ}C$ to $70\ ^{\circ}C$ , have been thoroughly investigated. The rate capability of the cells with different electrolytes at various current densities under $45\ ^{\circ}C$ was firstly studied, as illustrated in Fig. 4a. The $NaPF_{6}-E$ and NaFSI-E cells showed similar rate capabilities, while the NaDFOB-E cell exhibited inferior performance. Conversely, the cycling performance as shown in Fig. 4b indicated that the NaDFOB-E and NaFSI-E cells were more stable than the $NaPF_{6}-E$ cell, and following $70\ ^{\circ}C$ storage experiment results also confirmed that NaDFOB-E and NaFSI-E cells had better performance than $NaPF_{6}-E$ cell, as shown in Fig. 4c.

Preparation of the functional electrolytes and batteries
Ethylene carbonate (EC), ethyl methyl carbonate (EMC), $NaPF_{6}$ , NaFSI and NaDFOB were provided by the Guangzhou Tinci Materials Technology Co, Ltd. NaFSI, $NaPF_{6}$ and NaDFOB ( $\geq98\%$ ) were also provided by Guangzhou Tinci Materials Technology Co, Ltd (Table S1). Three electrolytes with 0.8 M concentration were all prepared by dissolving sodium salt in a mixture of EC: EMC = 3:7, and the electrolytes were represented as X-E, where X was the lithium salt used. All electrolytes were prepared in a dry argon filled glove box with both moisture and oxygen concentrations below 0.1 ppm. $NaNi_{1/3}Fe_{1/3}Mn_{1/3}O_{2}$ (NFM) active material was purchased from Jiangsu Xiangying New Energy Technology Co, Ltd, hard carbon (HC) active material was purchased from Kuraray Co Ltd. Pouch cells were assembled using a NFM cathode (120 mAh g $^{-1}$ at 0.1C), a HC (290 mAh g $^{-1}$ at 0.05C) anode, and a celgard 2700 separator. For the preparation of NFM cathode, NFM, polyvinylidene difluoride (PVDF), carbon nanotube (CNT), conductive carbon black (Super P), and Maleic acid were dispersed in N-methylpyrrolidone (NMP) with a mass ratio of 94.5:1.8:1:2.5:0.2, and the slurry was coated on an aluminum substrate. For the HC anode, HC, sodium carboxymethyl cellulose (CMC), styrene-butadiene rubber (SBR), and conductive carbon black (Super P) with a mass ratio of 95:1.5:2:1.5 were mixed and dispersed in water, and then the slurry was coated on an aluminum substrate. The areal loading of the anode and cathode was 16 g m $^{-2}$ and 33 g m $^{-2}$ , respectively. The cell cores were prepared by stacking with a separator separating the anodes (11) and cathodes (10), and then packaged in a plastic-laminated aluminum pouch. The resultant pouch cell was dried under vacuum at 80 °C for 72 h before being moved into a glove box for injecting electrolyte. The size of prepared pouch cells was 52 mm × 5 mm × 100 mm. All other preparations involved were carried out using methods commonly used in commercial battery manufacturing.

对于容量骤降、首圈库仑效率低、高压衰减、阻抗增长等 `inverse_design` 问题，先从检索证据中建立至少两个可区分的电解液侧假设，并提出能区分它们的 EIS、Raman、XPS、LSV、ICP、产气或对照实验。仍执行候选配方筛选，但筛选 `hold` 只禁止“推荐进入实验”的完整配方；不得因此省略诊断、混杂因素和条件化调整方向。报告必须区分“已被证据支持的诊断事实”与“待验证的调整方向”。

1. 解析用户目标与约束；把用户要求的每项条件写成结构化 `constraint_records`，例如：
   不得把整段用户问题放入 `target_conditions`，再把旧文本检查识别到的部分词语当成全部要求。
   推荐前逐项核对用户要求与检查条件，避免漏掉正极、负极、电池形式、温度、倍率或指标定义。
   检索前先解释用户给出的数值条件：它描述什么物理量、单位如何理解、哪些信息尚不明确。
   这一解释依据用户描述的工作场景，在检索前定下，不能由后来检索到的论文或知识图谱记录
   反过来改写；其它论文里恰好出现同样的 “N C” 写法，只说明那些论文的用法，不能用来判断
   用户这句话。
   温度与倍率的单位必须分清。省略度符号的 C 不能直接视为充放电倍率。
   按它在句中的位置判断：直接修饰电芯、电池或其使用环境时（如 “a pouch cell at -30 C”、
   “a full cell around 50 C”），是温度；只有与充放电动作或倍率词连用时
   （如 “discharged at 1 C”、“cycled at 0.5 C”、“1 C rate”），才是倍率。
   按上下文确定一种解释后，就用这一种建立约束，
   不因缺少度符号再补一条互斥的倍率或温度约束，也不因检索结果改回另一种解释。
   检索查询和筛选断言须明确写出所采用的
   物理量与单位。只有上下文确实无法确定物理量时，才同时列出两种解释并说明需要澄清，
   此时暂缓推荐，而不是把两种解释同时写成两条互斥的数值约束。
   接近目标温度的文献结果应保留实测温度，不能改写为目标温度。
   硬约束来自用户问题，不得自行加上某一正极、软包形式、长循环寿命或数值阈值。
   在若干可替代选项之间尚未确定时（例如某类溶剂或某类盐有多种候选），不得把它们
   同时写成必需的 `required_component`；每个选项应作为独立候选分别比较，不叠加互斥的必需组分。
   近似目标也必须进入筛选，不得因用户没有给出容差而省略。保留用户对目标的原话，
   用现有 `evidence_claim` 表达候选须有相应工况下的直接测试依据，而非把近似目标
   改成精确相等、单边不等式或自行设定容差。逐候选判断时，`supported` 须引用该
   候选的实际测试条件与性能原句，`basis` 写清实测条件与目标的差别及其关联依据。
   只有其他工况的结果、测试建议或机理预测时，不能据此判近似工况要求已满足。
   没有相应测试依据就保留 `not_found` 并补证，不能删掉该要求后批准推荐，再把它
   放进 `next_steps`。有邻近条件下的直接依据时，在报告中明确实际条件与目标的
   差别，精确目标下的后续验证可以另列。电极、电池形式和其他明确要求仍须检查。
   联合条件也须保留近似目标的含义：不得把近似值写成 `target_context` 中要求
   精确匹配的数值。近似工况及其电极、全电池归属可写在同一 `evidence_claim`
   中，引用实际共同测试的结果；组分身份等与工况无关的要求不并入该测试条件组。
   “低成本”等定性目标须区分文献提出的成本动机与已量化的价格优势；未提供价格数据
   时不得称已验证低成本。数值明确的用户要求仍按原值建立硬约束，不得因此放宽。
   无法从问题得出数值判据的定性目标，保留为选材目标，在报告中说明依据和待验证
   条件。定性或近似目标通过断言及其原文依据判断，不变成必须命中字面词的关键词条件。
   这不允许省略用户明确给出的电极、电池形式、精确温度或倍率要求。
   当用户目标包含某项性能指标（如 capacity retention relative to room-temperature
   capacity、离子电导率、倍率性能、首圈库仑效率），先分清用户给的是**数值阈值**还是
   **只要报告**：给了明确数值时写成对应数值约束——保持率用 `minimum_retention`、
   电导率用 `minimum_conductivity`、倍率用 `c_rate`，`value` 取用户给出的数值；
   只要求“报告该指标”“有无该结果”而未给数值时，不得把阈值填 0 了事——`value: 0`
   会让任何数字都通过，等于没有检查。这类“须被报告/须成立”的指标改用
   `kind: "evidence_claim"`（见下），把该指标写成一句断言。
   `field_presence` 只用于检查候选的配方字段（`concentration_mol_l`、
   `solvent_ratios`、`additives` 等）是否显式填写，绝不用于表达“某项性能必须被报告”。
   禁止把“capacity retention … must be reported”写成
   `"kind": "field_presence", "field": "additives"` 这类把性能指标错配到配方字段的约束。
   ```json
   {
     "request": {
       "candidates": candidates,
       "constraint_records": [
         {
           "constraint_id": "temp-low",
           "description": "operating temperature ≤ -20°C",
           "kind": "temperature",
           "operator": "<=",
           "value": -20,
           "unit": "°C",
           "required_evidence_scope": "candidate_same_paper",
           "can_replan": true,
           "search_hint": "find low-temperature cycling evidence"
         },
         {
           "constraint_id": "electrode-hard-carbon",
           "description": "hard carbon anode",
           "kind": "electrode_material",
           "evidence_terms": ["hard carbon", "hard-carbon"],
           "required_evidence_scope": "candidate_same_paper",
           "can_replan": true,
           "search_hint": "find hard carbon anode evidence"
         },
         {
           "constraint_id": "cell-half",
           "description": "sodium half-cell configuration",
           "kind": "cell_configuration",
           "evidence_terms": ["half-cell", "half cell", "Na||HC", "HC||Na", "pure Na"],
           "required_evidence_scope": "candidate_same_paper",
           "can_replan": true,
           "search_hint": "find half-cell configuration evidence"
         },
         {
           "constraint_id": "field-concentration",
           "description": "explicit salt concentration must be present",
           "kind": "field_presence",
           "field": "concentration_mol_l",
           "required_evidence_scope": "candidate_same_paper",
           "can_replan": false
         },
         {
           "constraint_id": "salt-napf6",
           "description": "NaPF6 as salt",
           "kind": "required_component",
           "value": "NaPF6",
           "required_evidence_scope": "candidate_same_paper",
           "can_replan": true,
           "search_hint": "find NaPF6 electrolyte evidence"
         },
         {
           "constraint_id": "solvent-thf",
           "description": "THF as solvent",
           "kind": "required_component",
           "value": "THF",
           "required_evidence_scope": "candidate_same_paper",
           "can_replan": true,
           "search_hint": "find THF solvent evidence"
         }
       ]
     }
   }
   ```
   定性或断言型要求（如“无集流体/壳体腐蚀被观测到”“无析钠/无枝晶”“提高首圈库仑效率”
   “该添加剂抑制产气”）不得写成 `mechanism_keyword` 关键词表——关键词命中分不清
   “发生腐蚀”与“未发生腐蚀”。改用 `kind: "evidence_claim"`：在 `claim` 里用一句
   用户原话写出对单个候选须成立的断言，在 `claim_verdicts` 里**逐候选**给出判定。
   语义判断（这段原文是否为该候选建立或推翻该断言）由你负责；程序只做两件可机械
   核验的事：判定须指向本次请求的候选，`quote` 须在该候选证据正文中逐字存在。
   因此措辞、否定、同义称呼的变化都不影响判定，你只需如实读原文：
   - `supported`：有原文明确为该候选建立断言，附 `chunk_id` 与逐字 `quote`；
   - `refuted`：有原文明确反驳（如原文说“会持续腐蚀铝箔”），附 `chunk_id` 与逐字 `quote`；
   - `not_found`：检索到的证据未直接提及，如实填写，由补证机制驱动下一轮检索。
   背景介绍、他人体系的结果、无实验支撑的预测都不算 `supported`。例如：
   ```json
   {
     "constraint_id": "no-corrosion",
     "description": "no current-collector or case corrosion observed",
     "kind": "evidence_claim",
     "claim": "该候选电解液不腐蚀铝箔或钢壳",
     "claim_verdicts": [
       {
         "candidate_id": "candidate-1",
         "verdict": "refuted",
         "chunk_id": "fan2024::sec3",
         "quote": "the single NaFSI system can continuously corrode aluminum foil and stainless steel sheets",
         "basis": "原文明确说明单盐 NaFSI 会持续腐蚀铝箔与不锈钢，与该断言相反。"
       }
     ],
     "can_replan": true,
     "search_hint": "find corrosion test evidence for the candidate electrolyte"
   }
   ```
   `evidence_claim` 不得把 `required_evidence_scope` 设为 `component` 或 `background`：
   断言必须由候选自身绑定的证据支持，不能借用别篇论文或背景段落的措辞。
   给出 `supported` 前，逐句核对引文是否真正支持所写断言。引文必须从指定
   `chunk_id` 返回的原文复制，不能把题名、摘要或另一块文字放在该块的标识下。
   配方、测试条件和性能必须对应同一候选；一种优点不能替代另一项目标的证据。
   成本动机与价格比较分别表述，安全性或无氟组成不能自行推导出成本优势。
   `basis` 说明原句与断言的推理关系，不得以重复断言代替理由。程序核验引文
   存在及归属，不代替科学含义判断；证据未支持完整断言时应补证或保留 `not_found`。
   `criteria`/`target_conditions` 仅用于兼容旧调用方；新设计任务必须优先使用
   `constraint_records`，避免 evaluator 再从自由文本猜测硬约束。

   `required_evidence_kinds` 描述的是**支持记录本身的语义角色**，不是实验条件元数据。
   数值性能约束通常只要求 `property`；温度、电极、循环数等共同实例化条件应由该
   observation 的 `condition_scope` 和 `joint_context_requirements` 表达。除非硬约束本身
   确实要求一条独立的 condition 记录，否则不要把同一数值约束写成
   `required_evidence_kinds=["property", "condition"]`，否则会把“带条件上下文的性能观测”
   错当成缺少第二种证据角色。

   当两个及以上硬约束必须在**同一个目标实验上下文**中同时成立时，还必须显式写
   `joint_context_requirements`。分别在多个倍率测试的要求，按倍率分别建立条件组，
   每组的 `target_context.rate` 只填一个倍率。不能把 `0.5 C and 1 C` 当成一次测试的倍率。
   同一论文的不同盐浓度或溶剂比例必须分别对应其性能段，不能因来自同篇论文就互换结果。
   `target_context.cell_configuration` 使用条件检查器的外形名称 `pouch` 或 `coin`，
   不拼成 `pouch full cell` 这样的新标签。全电池要求另用 cell_configuration 检查条件
   和明确的正负极对验证；外形名称不能代替电极与全电池要求。
   它描述的是 evidence composition obligation，不要求所有
   支持证据拥有相同 `experiment_id`。`constraint_ids` 只能引用本次 `constraint_records`；
   `context_fields` 只列对联合决策真正相关的字段；`target_context` 只填写用户明确给出的
   目标条件，未知字段保持未知，禁止为了让 join 成立而补默认值。例如：
   ```json
   {
     "joint_context_requirements": [
       {
         "group_id": "low-temp-high-voltage",
         "constraint_ids": ["retention", "voltage"],
         "context_fields": ["temperature_c", "electrode"],
         "target_context": {"temperature_c": -20.0, "electrode": "hard carbon"},
         "can_replan": true,
         "search_hint": "find evidence satisfying both hard constraints at the target operating context"
       }
     ]
   }
   ```
   只有约束确实需要共同实例化时才声明 joint group；互不相关的硬约束不要强行合组。
   原文条件检查器分别识别 `electrode` 与 `cell_configuration`。涉及电池形式的用户要求
   使用独立的 cell_configuration 条件；只有相关观测明确提供该字段时，才作联合检查。
2. 检查用户输入与已有 ledger；存在组分、机理或替代体系缺口时，选择相应检索能力；
3. 如证据不足，再做有界补充检索：
   - 区分“已有候选缺少一段证据”和“已有候选并不适合目标”。先检查最相关论文；
     若当前候选仍不能满足目标，按缺口与完整目标检索其他候选，不反复只查原来的
     盐、溶剂或论文。新证据支持新的组成时重新组装候选，再用原任务的全部条件
     筛选。不能把不同候选的成本、工况或性能拼成一个通过的候选。
   - 尚未定位候选论文时，用 `search_literature_chunks` 做 1–2 次聚焦补充（`top_k=10`）；
   - 若返回结果已经给出明确 `paper_id`，且该论文与目标组分/机理直接相关但缺少显式配方或目标工况证据，必须对最相关的 1 篇论文调用一次 `search_paper_chunks(paper_id=..., query=..., top_k=8)`；`query` 用 4–8 个英文技术词描述缺失事实，不含作者名。将结果追加到 `evidence_chunks`，不得跨论文拼接配方与性能。
   - 对 **named-study / named-candidate** 设计任务，在进入 `query_formulation_space` 或
     `screen_formulations` 前，必须先取得同一论文中可追溯的配方/组成证据：至少有一条
     `evidence_kind="formulation"` 的记录能支持候选的盐、溶剂或添加剂组成。只有性能、温度、
     机理 chunk 不能建立候选配方归属；若当前只找到性能证据，应继续检索 formulation /
     composition 段落，而不是手工构造一个 `formulation_evidence_ids=[]` 的候选进入筛选。
4. 用户没有提供可评估候选时，调用 `query_formulation_space`，把目标转成：
   `{"request":{"task_type":"design","target_conditions":[...],"preferred_salts":[...],"preferred_solvents":[...],"preferred_additives":[...],"excluded_components":[...],"evidence_chunks": evidence_chunks,"max_candidates":3}}`；其中 `evidence_chunks` 必须传入前面检索实际返回、与目标最相关的最多 12 个 chunk，不得只传组分偏好而丢失文献上下文。工具会优先从这些同论文原文块组装候选，再使用 KG fallback；保留工具原样返回的 `candidates`。
   如果候选 evidence 只有 `chunk_id` 而 `text/excerpt` 为空，先调用
   `enrich_formulation_evidence({"request":{"candidates": candidates}})`，并用返回候选
   替换原列表；证据已有原文时不得为形式完整重复调用。enrichment 只补齐原文和元数据，
   必须保留原 evidence 的 `paper_id`、`evidence_kind` 和 `chunk_id`。
5. 若任务涉及离子电导率、温度下的传输性质或需要在多个 NaPF6–EC/EMC/PC 候选之间增加一个轻量定量参考，可在筛选前调用 `predict_formulation_conductivity`。只有以下两种情况允许数值预测：候选已有明确的 NaPF6/EC/EMC/PC 摩尔组成，或调用参数中的 `composition_inputs[candidate_id]` 显式给出 `component_mmol`、`molar_ratios` 或 `x_NaSalt/x_EC/x_PC`。现有 `solvent_ratios` 没有保存 v/v、w/w 或 molar 基准，因此**不得**仅凭“1 M + 1:1”之类字段推导模型输入。含其他盐、其他溶剂或添加剂的候选按域外处理；组成不足时保留 `insufficient_composition`，继续依赖文献/KG 证据。`model_predictions` 与 literature evidence 必须分开：模型预测可以辅助候选比较和后续实验优先级，但不能单独把实验事实型硬约束判为满足。
6. 只有需要形成配方推荐或明确 hold 时才调用 `screen_formulations`：
   传入当前候选和完整的结构化 `constraint_records`。旧文本字段用于兼容历史输入，
   新设计任务不能用它们替代结构化条件。
   每项 `claim_verdicts` 只判定本次 `candidates` 中实际提交的候选。候选集合变更时，
   同步更新各断言的候选判定，保持原任务的全部条件。工具返回参数错误后，修复
   指出的字段并重新提交完整请求，不得删去 `constraint_records` 或联合条件来消除报错。
    倍率与循环次数是两种不同测试，分别建立约束：指定 1 C 测试使用
    `{"kind":"c_rate","operator":"==","value":1,"unit":"C"}`；
    100 次循环使用 `{"kind":"minimum_cycles","value":100,"unit":"cycles"}`。
    指定 2.0–4.0 V 测试使用
    `{"kind":"voltage_window","operator":"==","value":[2.0,4.0],"unit":"V"}`。
    若任务要求 0.5 C 和 1 C，各自建立条件。
    双盐配方同时保存 `salts` 与 `salt_concentrations_mol_l`，分别记录各盐浓度；
    `concentration_mol_l` 表示总盐浓度，不得将它归给某一个盐。
    `solvent_ratio_basis` 按原文填写 `mass`、`volume` 或 `molar`；原文未说明时填
    `unknown`。不得把质量比例当成体积比例，或把溶剂比例直接当成包括盐的摩尔组成。
   若本任务已声明 `joint_context_requirements`，每次首次筛选和补证后的重新筛选都必须携带
   同一份 joint-context 合同；除非用户明确修改任务目标，否则不得在 re-screen 时删除、
   放宽 `context_fields` 或改写 `target_context`。runtime 会在字段被意外省略时保留上一版
   显式合同，但 Agent 仍应主动原样传递。
   保留工具原样返回的 `screening_results`、其中的 `criteria_evaluations` 与 `gaps`，
   不得手写分数、validations 或 scores。任何 `failed`、`insufficient_evidence` 或
   `unsupported` 判定都不得在报告中表述为性能已验证。
7. 旧调用方需要动作列表时，可调用 `optimize_formulations`：
   `{"candidates": candidates,"screening_results": screening_results,"request":{"task_type":"design","objectives":[目标性能...],"constraints":[用户硬约束...]}}`。
   不得同时传入 `validations` 或 `scores`。该兼容工具只翻译筛选后已经产生的
   `DecisionState`，不会再按 score 独立裁决；若 proposal 为
   `retrieve_more_evidence`，先执行对应的补充检索和重新筛选，再进入报告。
8. `DecisionState` 已达到 `recommend` 或 `hold` 后，必须**立即**调用 `synthesize_design_report`
   生成完整报告，并传入同一份原始 `screening_results`：
   `{"request":{"task_type":"design","question":用户问题,"evidence_chunks": evidence_chunks,"candidates": candidates,"screening_results": screening_results}}`。
   为提升 `claim_supported_ratio`，请在 `request.claims` 中提交**所有**被 `evidence_chunks` 直接支持的事实声明（`claim_type="fact"`），每条包含 `text`、对应 `chunk_id` 和唯一逐字原文引文 `evidence_quote`（必须从该 chunk 的 `content` 中逐字截取，且只出现一次）。**禁止为凑数量编造 claim**；若当前证据能直接支持的 claim 不足 2 条，应优先通过 `search_literature_chunks` 或 `search_paper_chunks` 补充检索，最多尝试 2 轮；若仍无法找到更多直接支持，则在报告中明确标注“证据不足”，并只提交已被验证的 claim。报告将渲染“已校验事实”小节，避免裁判从自由文本中抽取不被检索上下文支持的论断。
   报告要让使用者能安排下一步工作。用简明中文分别提交配方组成、文献的测试条件与数值、同条件基准配方的结果，并保留逐字引文。比例需说明质量比或体积比；浓度、添加剂用量不得省略或猜测。文献筛选不能写成新配方已由本智能体实验验证。
   当目标是某项性能时，报告必须包含已检索到的该项性能结果，不能只列出温度、
   电极和电压范围等测试设置。不同盐浓度、溶剂比例和添加剂分支的结果分别绑定到
   其配方。不得借用另一分支较好的结果；保留同一分支完整组成与性能已明确的候选，
   不必强求选取数值最高但组成仍缺失的分支。
   `next_steps` 按本次缺口列出具体核查或实验，包括要比较的配方、温度、倍率、电池类型和测量项目；这些是验证计划，不是已取得的结果。即使为 `hold`，也要展示已取得的候选资料、文献结果和暂缓原因，不得只写状态或检索流程。
   对没有数值判据的选材目标，`next_steps` 也要交代其验证状态。例如成本目标
   需要区分文献的成本动机与实际价格比较，不能因筛选通过就宣称全部目标已验证。
   性能类 `claims` 应优先包含与当前候选直接相连的实验结果，少选一般背景介绍。
   **关键纪律**：一旦 `screen_formulations` 返回 `hold` 或 `recommend`，**不得**再尝试重新构建候选、重新检索或输出自由文本；下一动作必须是 `synthesize_design_report`。若状态为 `search`，最多只做一轮补充检索 + 重新筛选，然后必须进入报告。
9. 直接输出报告全文，不得改写或截断。

## 退出纪律

- 不要求无条件调用所有工具；根据用户已有候选和结构化 evidence gaps 选择能力。
- `synthesize_design_report` 是终端编译能力。调用前必须已有终态 `DecisionState`；
  `search` 状态必须先按缺口补证或换候选，不能用固定工具次数代替状态判断。
- `recommend` 只推荐 approved candidates；`hold` 展示已检索的候选资料与文献结果，说明缺口和验证计划，不推荐或排序候选。

## 候选方案纪律

- 候选配方必须来自 KG 结构化证据或文献 chunk；
- 对于"建议组合"（无完整配方直接实验数据），summary 只写组分和证据来源，不写性能声明；
- 性能/效果声明只能绑定到直接支持该声明的 chunk_id；
- 禁止在"证据摘要"里写入未被任何 chunk 直接支持的推断句；无来源支撑的直接删除；
- **直接回答（direct_answer）只给出候选方案标识和最精简组成**，不要包含"已在某温度验证"、"性能最优"、"最有效"等需要跨证据推断的断言；
- 推荐完整配方必须有原文明确的钠盐浓度。若浓度未知，列为待补资料，不得填入
  “参考基准配方”的浓度并作为已有文献验证的配方推荐。

## 推荐/排序纪律

- 排序理由必须逐条绑定到具体 chunk_id，禁止写"C1/C3/C4 无法满足需求"、"某候选明显优于其他"等无直接对比证据的绝对化断言；
- 无直接对比证据时，只陈述各候选的组分、证据来源与评分，不给出相对优劣结论；
- 对"建议组合"的推荐，只能说明其组分和所依据的证据，不得把多篇证据的性能迁移到该组合上。

## 证据摘要纪律

- 配方段落若讨论多种浓度、多个溶剂比例或不同研究，先定位到单一配方的原文。
  不得把某段的浓度、另一配方的溶剂比例和第三个体系的添加剂拼成候选。
  原文工具返回中的数值、温度符号、配方标识和 chunk_id 应原样沿用，
  不得手工改写成另一温度或用整篇论文的共同身份代替相同测试条件。
- 每条 bullet 必须附带 `[chunk_id]`；
- 禁止输出以"【推断】"开头的句子；
- 禁止把多篇证据的性能迁移到某个候选配方上。

## 引用纪律

- 使用 `[chunk_id]` 格式；
- 禁止引用模型参数知识里的文献；
- 单篇报道就写"某文献报道/某体系显示"，不得升格为普适结论。

## KG 质量反馈

检索或分析过程中，若发现以下可疑情况，**必须**调用 `flag_suspicious_kg_item` 记录，供后续离线人工审查与 KG 矫正；不阻塞当前设计流程。

- **实体标签错误**：如 `ionic conductivity` 被标为 `Additive`，`NaPF6` 被标为 `Solvent`；
- **关系方向/语义错误**：如 `SEI DECOMPOSITION::FORMS::FEC`、明显违背化学常识的关系；
- **属性单位或数值异常**：如电导率 `100 mS/cm` 与上下文矛盾、温度单位混用；
- **同名异义**：如 `TMP` 同时指 `trimethyl phosphate` 与 `2,4,6-trimethylpyridine` 而未区分；
- **证据与 KG 矛盾**：chunk 中的明确结论与 KG 检索结果冲突。

记录时尽量提供：item_type（`entity`/`relation`/`property`）、具体名称/ID、问题描述、触发工具、证据 chunk_id。

## 知识沉淀

设计流程全部结束后，调用 `reflect_now` 进行知识反思和 Wiki 沉淀，
将本次设计的关键结论、发现的知识缺口、改进的检索关键词记录到 LLM Wiki，
供下次相似问题时直接检索复用，减少重复检索成本。

The effect of sodium salts on the safety is also an important factor for commercial SIBs, and the corrosion of battery devices is one of the reference bases for sodium salt selection. Fig. 3e and f shows the corrosion results of Al foil in different electrolytes. As is reported at previous research, NaFSI-E would corrode Al foil during cycling so that may cause safety issues where NaDFOB-E and $\mathrm{NaPF_6 - E}$ hardly react. The coin cell was used to evaluate the corrosion of Al foil in different electrolytes. Surprisingly, although it can still observe obvious corrosion products on the glass fiber after cycling with NaFSI-E when measured with the coin cell, the Al foil inside the SIBs remains integrity, but the battery shell has obvious corrosion traces, as shown in Fig. 3g, which is quite different from the result measured by the electrolytic tank as shown in Fig. 3h. From this phenomenon, it can be inferred that NaFSI-E would corrode Al foil as well as stainless steel but corrode stainless steel first.

Battery performance is the most straightly and convincing evidence to evaluate the electrolytes with different sodium salts. At present stage, NFM and HC are widely considered as ideal cathode and anode materials for commercial pouch SIBs due to their duration to water and air $[23–26]$ . The electrochemical performance of NFM||HC pouch SIBs with various electrolytes including $NaPF_{6}$ , NaFSI and NaDFOB from $-40\ ^{\circ}C$ to $70\ ^{\circ}C$ , have been thoroughly investigated. The rate capability of the cells with different electrolytes at various current densities under $45\ ^{\circ}C$ was firstly studied, as illustrated in Fig. 4a. The $NaPF_{6}-E$ and NaFSI-E cells showed similar rate capabilities, while the NaDFOB-E cell exhibited inferior performance. Conversely, the cycling performance as shown in Fig. 4b indicated that the NaDFOB-E and NaFSI-E cells were more stable than the $NaPF_{6}-E$ cell, and following $70\ ^{\circ}C$ storage experiment results also confirmed that NaDFOB-E and NaFSI-E cells had better performance than $NaPF_{6}-E$ cell, as shown in Fig. 4c.

Ethylene carbonate (EC), ethyl methyl carbonate (EMC), $NaPF_{6}$ , NaFSI and NaDFOB were provided by the Guangzhou Tinci Materials Technology Co, Ltd. The element contents of three sodium salts are calculated and as an indicator to show their nature, as shown in Fig. 1a. Compared to the $\mathrm{NaPF_6}$ , NaFSI and NaDFOB own lower toxicity benefit to their lower F contents [17,18]. Then, DFT calculation was applied to evaluate the electrochemical stability of different sodium salts. Fig. 1b shows that $\mathrm{NaPF_6}$ owns the highest LUMO energy and lowest HOMO energy leading weakest reactivity. ABSTRACT: A functional electrolyte with trimethylsiloxybenzenesulfonate (TMBS) multigroup additive is developed to enhance the performance of $NaNi_{0.33}Fe_{0.33}Mn_{0.33}O_{2}$ (NFM)/hard carbon (HC) sodium-ion batteries (SIBs) from 60 to $-30^{\circ}C$ . Compared to the additive-free baseline electrolyte or the electrolytes containing monofunctional methylmethanesulfonate (MS) and methylbenzenesulfonate (MBS) additives, TMBS is more conducive to suppress the excessive side reactions at the anode and promoting the formation of robust cathode-electrolyte interphase (CEI) over a wide temperature range. TMBS-containing cells exhibit enhanced performance in overdischarge testing at $60^{\circ}C$ , rate capability and cycling stability at $45^{\circ}C$ , discharge performance at $-30^{\circ}C$ , as well as low-temperature cycling stability at $-10^{\circ}C$ . Besides, this work provides an effective additive design principle for pouch NFM/HC SIBs.

ABSTRACT: A functional electrolyte with trimethylsiloxybenzenesulfonate (TMBS) multigroup additive is developed to enhance the performance of $NaNi_{0.33}Fe_{0.33}Mn_{0.33}O_{2}$ (NFM)/hard carbon (HC) sodium-ion batteries (SIBs) from 60 to $-30^{\circ}C$ . Compared to the additive-free baseline electrolyte or the electrolytes containing monofunctional methylmethanesulfonate (MS) and methylbenzenesulfonate (MBS) additives, TMBS is more conducive to suppress the excessive side reactions at the anode and promoting the formation of robust cathode-electrolyte interphase (CEI) over a wide temperature range. TMBS-containing cells exhibit enhanced performance in overdischarge testing at $60^{\circ}C$ , rate capability and cycling stability at $45^{\circ}C$ , discharge performance at $-30^{\circ}C$ , as well as low-temperature cycling stability at $-10^{\circ}C$ . Besides, this work provides an effective additive design principle for pouch NFM/HC SIBs.

The effect of sodium salts on the safety is also an important factor for commercial SIBs, and the corrosion of battery devices is one of the reference bases for sodium salt selection. Fig. 3e and f shows the corrosion results of Al foil in different electrolytes. As is reported at previous research, NaFSI-E would corrode Al foil during cycling so that may cause safety issues where NaDFOB-E and $\mathrm{NaPF_6 - E}$ hardly react. The coin cell was used to evaluate the corrosion of Al foil in different electrolytes. From this phenomenon, it can be inferred that NaFSI-E would corrode Al foil as well as stainless steel but corrode stainless steel first.

Battery performance is the most straightly and convincing evidence to evaluate the electrolytes with different sodium salts. At present stage, NFM and HC are widely considered as ideal cathode and anode materials for commercial pouch SIBs due to their duration to water and air $[23–26]$ . The electrochemical performance of NFM||HC pouch SIBs with various electrolytes including $NaPF_{6}$ , NaFSI and NaDFOB from $-40\ ^{\circ}C$ to $70\ ^{\circ}C$ , have been thoroughly investigated. The rate capability of the cells with different electrolytes at various current densities under $45\ ^{\circ}C$ was firstly studied, as illustrated in Fig. 4a. The $NaPF_{6}-E$ and NaFSI-E cells showed similar rate capabilities, while the NaDFOB-E cell exhibited inferior performance. Conversely, the cycling performance as shown in Fig. 4b indicated that the NaDFOB-E and NaFSI-E cells were more stable than the $NaPF_{6}-E$ cell, and following $70\ ^{\circ}C$ storage experiment results also confirmed that NaDFOB-E and NaFSI-E cells had better performance than $NaPF_{6}-E$ cell, as shown in Fig. 4c.

ABSTRACT: A functional electrolyte with trimethylsiloxybenzenesulfonate (TMBS) multigroup additive is developed to enhance the performance of $NaNi_{0.33}Fe_{0.33}Mn_{0.33}O_{2}$ (NFM)/hard carbon (HC) sodium-ion batteries (SIBs) from 60 to $-30^{\circ}C$ . Compared to the additive-free baseline electrolyte or the electrolytes containing monofunctional methylmethanesulfonate (MS) and methylbenzenesulfonate (MBS) additives, TMBS is more conducive to suppress the excessive side reactions at the anode and promoting the formation of robust cathode-electrolyte interphase (CEI) over a wide temperature range. TMBS-containing cells exhibit enhanced performance in overdischarge testing at $60^{\circ}C$ , rate capability and cycling stability at $45^{\circ}C$ , discharge performance at $-30^{\circ}C$ , as well as low-temperature cycling stability at $-10^{\circ}C$ . Besides, this work provides an effective additive design principle for pouch NFM/HC SIBs.

evidence.text: The main raw materials (sodium salt, solvents, and additives), including ethylene carbonate (EC), ethyl methyl carbonate (EMC), and $NaPF_6$ , were supplied by Guangzhou Tinci Materials Technology Co., Ltd. The cathode material NFM was obtained from Jiangsu Xiangying New Energy Technology Co., Ltd., and anode material HC was purchased from Kuraray Co., Ltd. evidence.text: In this work, TMBS was synthesized via a one-pot method and developed as a bifunctional film-forming electrolyte additive to enhance the long-cycle stability of the NFM/HC cells. evidence.section_title: 3.1. Design and Performance of the Functional Electrolytes
evidence.text: In previous reports, it has been confirmed that there are notable differences between button cells and pouch cells under same testing conditions. $^{23}$ Therefore, in order to verify the feasibility of additives for commercial SIBs, pouch NFM/HC cells were used to evaluate the performance of different functional electrolytes. The rate and cycling tests of the cells at room temperature were conducted first, and the corresponding results are shown in Figure 2a,b. It can be seen that the MS- and MBS-containing cells show lower capacity than the cells with baseline and TMBS-containing electrolyte. Similar results were also observed in the cycling tests and the inferior Coulombic efficiency of MBS- and MS-containing cells. These results indicate that the EEI induced by MS or MBS is continuously broken and repaired during the cycling, leading to worse cycling performance than the cells with TMBS or baseline electrolytes. Figure 2c shows that the cycling performance differences of the cells with TMBS are more pronounced at lower temperatures. The capacity retention of the cells with TMBS is still high at 90% after 120 cycles, while the performance of the cells with other electrolytes sharply decays owing to the fluctuating Coulombic efficiency.

evidence.section_title: 2.1. Preparation of the functional electrolytes and batteries
evidence.text: The main raw materials used for preparing functional electrolytes, including EC, EMC, $NaPF_{6}$ , NaDFP, TMSP and TMSB were provided by the Guangzhou Tinci Materials Technology Co, Ltd. The baseline electrolyte was prepared by dissolving $NaPF_{6}$ in a mixture of EC: EMC=3:7 to form a concentration of 0.8 mol $L^{-1}$ . Then, NaDFP was added into the baseline electrolyte to prepare the NaDFP electrolyte, and NaDFP and TMSB or TMSP were respectively added into the baseline electrolyte and assigned as NB or NP electrolyte. All electrolytes were prepared in a dry argon filled glove box with both moisture and oxygen concentrations below 0.1 ppm. NFM was purchased from Jiangsu Xiangying New Energy Technology Co, Ltd, HC was purchased from Kuraray Co Ltd. The pouch test cells with NFM cathode (120 mAh g $^{-1}$ at 0.1 C), HC anode (290 mAh g $^{-1}$ at 0.05 C), and Celgard 2700 separator were assembled using the conventional assembly method. Therein, NFM active material, polyvinylidene difluoride (PVDF), carbon nanotube (CNT), conductive carbon black (Super P), and Maleic acid (the reason of addition maleic acid was shown in Table 1) were dispersed in $N$ -methylpyrrolidone (NMP) with a mass ratio of 94.5:1.8:1:2.5:0.2, and the slurry was coated on an aluminum substrate to prepare the NFM cathode.

evidence.section_title: 3.2. Electrochemical performance of pouch cells at $-30\ ^{\circ}C$ to $60\ ^{\circ}C$
evidence.text: With the help of "hard-soft synergy", polarization and capacity fading are alleviated signally during the cycling. Besides, rate performance of pouch cells is also improved by the synergistic effect of NP or NB electrolyte even at $-10^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$ and $1\mathrm{C}$ , as shown in Fig. 4d and S5b. Furthermore, to evaluate dual additive potential at tougher low-temperatures, $-20^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$ and $-30^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$ discharge tests are necessary. Fig. 4e shows the capacity retention of pouch cells at different discharge currents, revealing the cells all can exhibit good electrochemical performance under the tested temperature conditions. Even at $-30^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$ and $1\mathrm{C}$ , the discharge capacity of pouch cells with NP and NB electrolytes still achieves $729\mathrm{mAh}$ and $697\mathrm{mAh}$ , respectively. These results confirm that this co-additive addition strategy improves extremely low temperature performance of NFM/HC pouch cells. Summarily, compared to single additive or baseline electrolyte, NFM/HC pouch cells with multi-component functional electrolyte possess much better performance. Therein, the cells containing NP electrolyte have better room and high-temperature performance, and the cells containing NB electrolyte are more suitable for low-temperature application.

evidence.section_title: 4. Conclusion
evidence.text: In summary, “hard-soft synergy” strategy—reasonably coupling NaDFP with TMSP or TMSB as the functional electrolytes successfully achieved wide-temperature performance of pouch SIBs over a range of $-30^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$ to $60^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$ . Benefit to the high-quality and rich element optimized NaDFP-based CEI/SEI layers on the electrode surfaces, and optimizing electrolyte structure which decrease the desolvation energy and induce superior electrolyte properties, a high capacity retention of $92\%$ after 350 cycles and a stable cycling performance at $1\mathrm{C}$ were achieved even at $-10^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$ .

evidence.text: The effect of sodium salts on the safety is also an important factor for commercial SIBs, and the corrosion of battery devices is one of the reference bases for sodium salt selection. Fig. 3e and f shows the corrosion results of Al foil in different electrolytes. As is reported at previous research, NaFSI-E would corrode Al foil during cycling so that may cause safety issues where NaDFOB-E and $\mathrm{NaPF_6 - E}$ hardly react. The coin cell was used to evaluate the corrosion of Al foil in different electrolytes. Surprisingly, although it can still observe obvious corrosion products on the glass fiber after cycling with NaFSI-E when measured with the coin cell, the Al foil inside the SIBs remains integrity, but the battery shell has obvious corrosion traces, as shown in Fig. 3g, which is quite different from the result measured by the electrolytic tank as shown in Fig. 3h. From this phenomenon, it can be inferred that NaFSI-E would corrode Al foil as well as stainless steel but corrode stainless steel first. Battery performance is the most straightly and convincing evidence to evaluate the electrolytes with different sodium salts. At present stage, NFM and HC are widely considered as ideal cathode and anode materials for commercial pouch SIBs due to their duration to water and air $[23–26]$ .

evidence.paper_title: 0018_Fan 等 - 2026 - Multi-Group Functional Additive Enhances the Wide-Temperature-Range Performance of Sodium-Ion Batter
evidence.text: The main raw materials (sodium salt, solvents, and additives), including ethylene carbonate (EC), ethyl methyl carbonate (EMC), and $NaPF_6$ , were supplied by Guangzhou Tinci Materials Technology Co., Ltd. TMBS was synthesized via a one-pot method combined with in situ vacuum distillation, as shown in Figure S1. The baseline electrolyte was prepared by dissolving $NaPF_6$ in mixed solvents of EC:EMC = 3:7 to a concentration of 1 mol $L^{-1}$ . Considering the cost and usual dosage, the concentrations of all additives were 1%. The cathode material NFM was obtained from Jiangsu Xiangying New Energy Technology Co., Ltd., and anode material HC was purchased from Kuraray Co., Ltd. Pouch cells was assembled with an NFM cathode (121 mAh $g^{-1}$ at 0.1 C), an HC anode (293 mAh $g^{-1}$ at 0.05 C), and a Celgard 2700.

evidence.paper_title: 0018_Fan 等 - 2026 - Multi-Group Functional Additive Enhances the Wide-Temperature-Range Performance of Sodium-Ion Batter
evidence.text: In this work, TMBS was synthesized via a one-pot method and developed as a bifunctional film-forming electrolyte additive to enhance the long-cycle stability of the NFM/HC cells. The capacity retention of TMBS-containing cells after 100 cycles at $-10^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$ increased from $0\%$ (baseline electrolyte) to $90\%$ , and both the rate capacity and cycling stability improved greatly as well.

evidence.paper_title: 0018_Fan 等 - 2026 - Multi-Group Functional Additive Enhances the Wide-Temperature-Range Performance of Sodium-Ion Batter
evidence.text: In previous reports, it has been confirmed that there are notable differences between button cells and pouch cells under same testing conditions. $^{23}$ Therefore, in order to verify the feasibility of additives for commercial SIBs, pouch NFM/HC cells were used to evaluate the performance of different functional electrolytes. The rate and cycling tests of the cells at room temperature were conducted first, and the corresponding results are shown in Figure 2a,b. It can be seen that the MS- and MBS-containing cells show lower capacity than the cells with baseline and TMBS-containing electrolyte. Similar results were also observed in the cycling tests and the inferior Coulombic efficiency of MBS- and MS-containing cells. These results indicate that the EEI induced by MS or MBS is continuously broken and repaired during the cycling, leading to worse cycling performance than the cells with TMBS or baseline electrolytes. Figure 2c shows that the cycling performance differences of the cells with TMBS are more pronounced at lower temperatures. The capacity retention of the cells with TMBS is still high at 90% after 120 cycles, while the performance of the cells with other electrolytes sharply decays owing to the fluctuating Coulombic efficiency.

candidates.rationale: NFM/HC 软包电池用 1 mol L-1 NaPF6 / EC:EMC=3:7 基液 + 1 wt% TMBS 添加剂；原文报告 -10 °C 循环 100 次保持率由 0%（基液）提升到 90%。

evidence.text: Sodium hexafluorophosphate (NaPF $_6$ ), ethylene carbonate (EC), and methyl ethyl carbonate (EMC) were supplied by Guangzhou Tinci Materials Technology Co, Ltd. NaPF $_6$ was dissolved into a mixture of EC and EMC (EC: EMC = 3:7 in wt%) to prepare Baseline electrolyte (1 mol L $^{-1}$ ). TMSBS additive (1 wt%) was added to the Baseline electrolyte to form a functional electrolyte. NFM and HC active materials were purchased from Jiangsu Xiangying New Energy Technology Co., Ltd. and Kuraray Co., Ltd., respectively. The NFM cathode was fabricated from NFM active material, polyvinylidene difluoride (PVDF), carbon nanotubes (CNT), conductive carbon black (Super P), and maleic acid dispersed in $N$ -methylpyrrolidone (NMP) at a mass ratio of 94.5:1.8:1:2.5:0.2, and the slurry was coated onto an aluminium substrate. The HC anode contained 95% HC, 1.5% carboxymethyl cellulose (CMC), 2.0% styrene butadiene rubber (SBR), and 1.5% Super P. A Celgard 2700 membrane (Xingyuan Materials Co., Ltd) was used as the separator. The mass loading of the cathode and anode was 33.0 and 20.1 mg cm $^{-2}$ , respectively. The negative-to-positive (N/P) capacity ratio was 1.1. The empty pouch cells were dried under vacuum at 80 °C for 72 h, then transferred to a glove box, and injected 6.0 g of electrolyte.

evidence.paper_title: 0156_Cai 等 - 2025 - A hard-soft synergy strategy enables drastic temperature performance of pouch sodium-ion batteries o
evidence.text: The main raw materials used for preparing functional electrolytes, including EC, EMC, $NaPF_{6}$ , NaDFP, TMSP and TMSB were provided by the Guangzhou Tinci Materials Technology Co, Ltd. The baseline electrolyte was prepared by dissolving $NaPF_{6}$ in a mixture of EC: EMC=3:7 to form a concentration of 0.8 mol $L^{-1}$ . Then, NaDFP was added into the baseline electrolyte to prepare the NaDFP electrolyte, and NaDFP and TMSB or TMSP were respectively added into the baseline electrolyte and assigned as NB or NP electrolyte. All electrolytes were prepared in a dry argon filled glove box with both moisture and oxygen concentrations below 0.1 ppm. NFM was purchased from Jiangsu Xiangying New Energy Technology Co, Ltd, HC was purchased from Kuraray Co Ltd. The pouch test cells with NFM cathode (120 mAh g $^{-1}$ at 0.1 C), HC anode (290 mAh g $^{-1}$ at 0.05 C), and Celgard 2700 separator were assembled using the conventional assembly method. Therein, NFM active material, polyvinylidene difluoride (PVDF), carbon nanotube (CNT), conductive carbon black (Super P), and Maleic acid (the reason of addition maleic acid was shown in Table 1) were dispersed in $N$ -methylpyrrolidone (NMP) with a mass ratio of 94.5:1.8:1:2.5:0.2, and the slurry was coated on an aluminum substrate to prepare the NFM cathode.

evidence.chunk_id: 0156_Cai 等 - 2025 - A hard-soft synergy strategy enables drastic temperature performance of pouch sodium-ion batteries o::sec8::child3
evidence.paper_title: 0156_Cai 等 - 2025 - A hard-soft synergy strategy enables drastic temperature performance of pouch sodium-ion batteries o
evidence.text: With the help of "hard-soft synergy", polarization and capacity fading are alleviated signally during the cycling. Besides, rate performance of pouch cells is also improved by the synergistic effect of NP or NB electrolyte even at $-10^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$ and $1\mathrm{C}$ , as shown in Fig. 4d and S5b. Furthermore, to evaluate dual additive potential at tougher low-temperatures, $-20^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$ and $-30^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$ discharge tests are necessary. Fig. 4e shows the capacity retention of pouch cells at different discharge currents, revealing the cells all can exhibit good electrochemical performance under the tested temperature conditions. Even at $-30^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$ and $1\mathrm{C}$ , the discharge capacity of pouch cells with NP and NB electrolytes still achieves $729\mathrm{mAh}$ and $697\mathrm{mAh}$ , respectively. These results confirm that this co-additive addition strategy improves extremely low temperature performance of NFM/HC pouch cells. Summarily, compared to single additive or baseline electrolyte, NFM/HC pouch cells with multi-component functional electrolyte possess much better performance. Therein, the cells containing NP electrolyte have better room and high-temperature performance, and the cells containing NB electrolyte are more suitable for low-temperature application.

evidence.text: In summary, “hard-soft synergy” strategy—reasonably coupling NaDFP with TMSP or TMSB as the functional electrolytes successfully achieved wide-temperature performance of pouch SIBs over a range of $-30^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$ to $60^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$ . Benefit to the high-quality and rich element optimized NaDFP-based CEI/SEI layers on the electrode surfaces, and optimizing electrolyte structure which decrease the desolvation energy and induce superior electrolyte properties, a high capacity retention of $92\%$ after 350 cycles and a stable cycling performance at $1\mathrm{C}$ were achieved even at $-10^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$ .

evidence.text: The effect of sodium salts on the safety is also an important factor for commercial SIBs, and the corrosion of battery devices is one of the reference bases for sodium salt selection. Fig. 3e and f shows the corrosion results of Al foil in different electrolytes. As is reported at previous research, NaFSI-E would corrode Al foil during cycling so that may cause safety issues where NaDFOB-E and $\mathrm{NaPF_6 - E}$ hardly react. The coin cell was used to evaluate the corrosion of Al foil in different electrolytes. Surprisingly, although it can still observe obvious corrosion products on the glass fiber after cycling with NaFSI-E when measured with the coin cell, the Al foil inside the SIBs remains integrity, but the battery shell has obvious corrosion traces, as shown in Fig. 3g, which is quite different from the result measured by the electrolytic tank as shown in Fig. 3h. From this phenomenon, it can be inferred that NaFSI-E would corrode Al foil as well as stainless steel but corrode stainless steel first.

evidence_chunks.chunk_id: 0018_Fan 等 - 2026 - Multi-Group Functional Additive Enhances the Wide-Temperature-Range Performance of Sodium-Ion Batter::sec3::child0
evidence_chunks.content: The main raw materials (sodium salt, solvents, and additives), including ethylene carbonate (EC), ethyl methyl carbonate (EMC), and $NaPF_{6}$ , were supplied by Guangzhou Tinci Materials Technology Co., Ltd. TMBS was synthesized via a one-pot method combined with in situ vacuum distillation, as shown in Figure S1. The baseline electrolyte was prepared by dissolving $NaPF_{6}$ in mixed solvents of EC:EMC = 3:7 to a concentration of 1 mol $L^{-1}$ . Considering the cost and usual dosage, the concentrations of all additives were 1%. The cathode material NFM was obtained from Jiangsu Xiangying New Energy Technology Co., Ltd., and anode material HC was purchased from Kuraray Co., Ltd. Pouch cells was assembled with an NFM cathode (121 mAh $g^{-1}$ at 0.1 C), an HC anode (293 mAh $g^{-1}$ at 0.05 C), and a Celgard 2700. The NFM cathodes were prepared by the slurry with a mass ratio of 94.5:1.8:1:2.5:0.2 for NFM active material/polyvinylidene difluoride (PVDF)/carbon nanotube (CNT)/conductive carbon black (Super P)/maleic acid. The HC active material, sodium carboxymethyl cellulose (CMC), styrene–butadiene rubber (SBR), and conductive carbon black (Super P) with a mass ratio of 95:1.5:2:1.5 were mixed and dispersed in water, and then, the slurry was coated on an aluminum substrate to prepare the HC anode. The areal loadings of the NFM cathode and HC anode were 33 g $m^{-2}$ and 16 g $m^{-2}$ , respectively.

evidence_chunks.chunk_id: 0018_Fan 等 - 2026 - Multi-Group Functional Additive Enhances the Wide-Temperature-Range Performance of Sodium-Ion Batter::sec8::child0
evidence_chunks.content: In this work, TMBS was synthesized via a one-pot method and developed as a bifunctional film-forming electrolyte additive to enhance the long-cycle stability of the NFM/HC cells. The capacity retention of TMBS-containing cells after 100 cycles at $-10^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$ increased from $0\%$ (baseline electrolyte) to $90\%$ , and both the rate capacity and cycling stability improved greatly as well. The performance enhancement of the cells with the TMBS-containing electrolyte is ascribed to the suppression of excessive side reactions at the anode and the formation of robust CEI. This work also provides an effective electrolyte design strategy for the application of all-climate SIBs.

evidence_chunks.chunk_id: 0018_Fan 等 - 2026 - Multi-Group Functional Additive Enhances the Wide-Temperature-Range Performance of Sodium-Ion Batter::sec6::child2
evidence_chunks.content: In previous reports, it has been confirmed that there are notable differences between button cells and pouch cells under same testing conditions. $^{23}$ Therefore, in order to verify the feasibility of additives for commercial SIBs, pouch NFM/HC cells were used to evaluate the performance of different functional electrolytes. The rate and cycling tests of the cells at room temperature were conducted first, and the corresponding results are shown in Figure 2a,b. It can be seen that the MS- and MBS-containing cells show lower capacity than the cells with baseline and TMBS-containing electrolyte. Similar results were also observed in the cycling tests and the inferior Coulombic efficiency of MBS- and MS-containing cells. These results indicate that the EEI induced by MS or MBS is continuously broken and repaired during the cycling, leading to worse cycling performance than the cells with TMBS or baseline electrolytes. Figure 2c shows that the cycling performance differences of the cells with TMBS are more pronounced at lower temperatures. The capacity retention of the cells with TMBS is still high at 90% after 120 cycles, while the performance of the cells with other electrolytes sharply decays owing to the fluctuating Coulombic efficiency.

- No observed Al collector corrosion for the NaPF6 candidate：原文报告与 NaFSI-E 不同，NaPF6-E（及 NaDFOB-E）几乎不与该铝箔发生反应，属于对 NaPF6-E 在铝集流体上的直接阴性观察。 [0016_Fan 等 - 2025 - Electrolyte salts for large-scale application of sodium-ion batteries NaPF6 and emerging alternativ::sec9::child0]
- No observed stainless-steel shell corrosion for the NaPF6 candidate：原文在金属壳腐蚀对照中把腐蚀归因于 NaFSI-E，称其先腐蚀不锈钢壳体；同段将 NaPF6-E 与 NaDFOB-E 并列为“hardly react”的一类，据此对不锈钢壳体也给出 NaPF6-E 不腐蚀的阴性说明。 [0016_Fan 等 - 2025 - Electrolyte salts for large-scale application of sodium-ion batteries NaPF6 and emerging alternativ::sec9::child0]
- Low-temperature (-10 °C) cycle performance adequate for the target cell：原文在 -10 °C、1C 下测试 NFM||HC pouch cell，NaPF6-E 电芯在 50 循环后容量“sudden death”式骤降，而 NaFSI-E 保持 90 % 容量 200 循环；候选在目标低温下实测表现明显不足。 [0016_Fan 等 - 2025 - Electrolyte salts for large-scale application of sodium-ion batteries NaPF6 and emerging alternativ::sec9::child4]
- Overall conclusion that this candidate is the suitable low-temperature choice：原文结论指出 NaPF6 以外的 NaDFOB/NaFSI 值得关注，低温柔性由 NaFSI-E 在解决腐蚀后承担，NaPF6 并未被列为低温适用盐，故候选作为低温选择被原文否定。 [0016_Fan 等 - 2025 - Electrolyte salts for large-scale application of sodium-ion batteries NaPF6 and emerging alternativ::sec11::child0][0016_Fan 等 - 2025 - Electrolyte salts for large-scale application of sodium-ion batteries NaPF6 and emerging alternativ::sec3::child0]
文献与候选的关联：候选的盐种、浓度与溶剂比例（0.8 M NaPF6，EC:EMC = 3:7）与文献 NaPF6-E 完全对应；该文献用同一电解质装配 NFM||HC pouch cell 并进行 -40 至 70 °C 的宽温测试，因此铝集流体腐蚀、壳体腐蚀与 -10 °C 循环结果均直接关联到本候选，而非其它盐种电解质的结论。 [0016_Fan 等 - 2025 - Electrolyte salts for large-scale application of sodium-ion batteries NaPF6 and emerging alternativ::sec5::child0][0016_Fan 等 - 2025 - Electrolyte salts for large-scale application of sodium-ion batteries NaPF6 and emerging alternativ::sec9::child1][0016_Fan 等 - 2025 - Electrolyte salts for large-scale application of sodium-ion batteries NaPF6 and emerging alternativ::sec9::child4]

## 文献依据与已记录的计算结果
- The main raw materials (sodium salt, solvents, and additives), including ethylene carbonate (EC), ethyl methyl carbonate (EMC), and $NaPF_{6}$ , were supplied by Guangzhou Tinci Materials Technology Co., Ltd. TMBS was synthesized via a one-pot method combined with in situ vacuum distillation, as shown in Figure S1. [0018_Fan 等 - 2026 - Multi-Group Functional Additive Enhances the Wide-Temperature-Range Performance of Sodium-Ion Batter::sec3::child0]
- In this work, TMBS was synthesized via a one-pot method and developed as a bifunctional film-forming electrolyte additive to enhance the long-cycle stability of the NFM/HC cells. [0018_Fan 等 - 2026 - Multi-Group Functional Additive Enhances the Wide-Temperature-Range Performance of Sodium-Ion Batter::sec8::child0]
- In previous reports, it has been confirmed that there are notable differences between button cells and pouch cells under same testing conditions. $^{23}$ Therefore, in order to verify the feasibility of additives for commercial SIBs, pouch NFM/HC cells were used to evaluate the performance of different functional electrolytes. [0018_Fan 等 - 2026 - Multi-Group Functional Additive Enhances the Wide-Temperature-Range Performance of Sodium-Ion Batter::sec6::child2]

## 尚未满足的条件
- candidate-1-tmbs：The candidate composition (NaPF6 1 M, EC:EMC 3:7, 1% TMBS) and NFM||HC pouch format match the source, and the -10 C cycling benefit is supported. However, the program's hard requirement of no observed collector or shell corrosion is unverified, and the candidate uses a pouch format with no stainless-steel shell evidence, so a structured hold is warranted rather than a recommendation. No computation predictions were available to add further support.
- candidate-1-tmbs：No observed corrosion of the Al current collector：The source only notes that the HC slurry was coated on an aluminum substrate; it reports no corrosion observation or test for Al, and the anti-corrosion reference cited is a general literature entry, not a result for this electrolyte/cell.
- candidate-1-tmbs：No observed corrosion of the stainless-steel shell：The work uses pouch cells and contains no statement about a stainless-steel shell or its corrosion behavior; no negative observation is reported.
- candidate-1-tmbs：Direct observation or test confirming no Al current-collector corrosion for the candidate electrolyte in the target cell.
- candidate-1-tmbs：Direct observation or test confirming no stainless-steel shell corrosion for the candidate electrolyte in the target cell.
- candidate-2-tmsbs：低温与目标电池构型有来源支持，但原问题要求的“未观察到集流体或壳腐蚀”缺乏直接阴性证据，故暂缓推荐并保留该空缺。
- candidate-2-tmsbs：No observed corrosion of the Al current collector or the stainless-steel shell：来源描述了性能、界面膜与产气抑制，但未提供该候选对各集流体或钢壳腐蚀的阴性观察，无法据此判定无腐蚀。
- candidate-2-tmsbs：针对Al集流体和不锈钢壳的未腐蚀阴性观察或等价验证
- candidate-3-nb-dfp：The candidate's low-temperature NFM/HC pouch performance is well supported, but the program's hard requirement of no observed Al collector or stainless-steel shell corrosion has no supporting (or any) evidence in the retrieved sources, so a recommendation cannot be justified yet and the decision is held.
- candidate-3-nb-dfp：Stainless-steel shell/casing compatibility：The retrieved text describes the pouch cell size and layers but never states the shell/casing material or any stainless-steel component, so no evidence bears on stainless-steel compatibility.
- candidate-3-nb-dfp：No observed Al collector or stainless-steel shell corrosion：No source reports a direct negative observation (no corrosion/leaching/deposition) for this candidate on the Al collector or a stainless-steel shell; the paper's overall good cycling does not constitute the required negative observation.
- candidate-3-nb-dfp：Stainless-steel shell/casing material and its compatibility with the NaDFP+TMSB electrolyte
- candidate-3-nb-dfp：Direct negative observation (no corrosion/dissolution/deposition) of the Al current collector or stainless-steel shell for this candidate
- candidate-4-nafsi-0016：The candidate matches the requested salt/concentration/solvent and pouch NFM||HC format and shows strong -10 °C cycling, but the hard requirement of no collector or shell corrosion is refuted: additive-free NaFSI-E corrodes Al foil and especially the stainless-steel shell, and the paper only endorses NaFSI-E for low temperature after an additive fixes corrosion. Without such an additive the candidate cannot be recommended, so a hold decision is issued pending an additive that suppresses corrosion.
- candidate-4-nafsi-0016：No observed corrosion of the Al current collector：The paper states NaFSI-E corrodes Al foil during cycling (prior research) and shows Al corrosion products on the glass fiber in coin-cell testing; the text concludes NaFSI-E would corrode Al foil as well as stainless steel, so the required absence of Al corrosion is not met.
- candidate-4-nafsi-0016：No observed corrosion of the stainless-steel shell：For the pouch cell the Al foil remained intact but the battery shell showed obvious corrosion traces (Fig. 3g), and the authors infer NaFSI-E corrodes stainless steel (even preferentially), directly contradicting the required absence of shell corrosion.
- candidate-4-nafsi-0016：NaFSI without additives suffices for low-temperature application：The conclusion explicitly states NaFSI-E is suitable for low-temperature application only after solving its corrosion by an additive; this additive-free candidate therefore does not meet the corrosion constraint.
- candidate-5-napf6-baseline：候选 NaPF6-E 与目标电解质的盐种/浓度/溶剂比例一致，且铝集流体与不锈钢壳体均无腐蚀迹象；但其在目标 -10 °C 下迅速失效（50 循环后 sudden death），文献将低温柔性归于 NaFSI-E（解决腐蚀后），故不推荐本候选作为该低温电芯的电解质，建议保持/转向文献支持的低温候选。
- candidate-5-napf6-baseline：Low-temperature (-10 °C) cycle performance adequate for the target cell：原文在 -10 °C、1C 下测试 NFM||HC pouch cell，NaPF6-E 电芯在 50 循环后容量“sudden death”式骤降，而 NaFSI-E 保持 90 % 容量 200 循环；候选在目标低温下实测表现明显不足。
- candidate-5-napf6-baseline：Overall conclusion that this candidate is the suitable low-temperature choice：原文结论指出 NaPF6 以外的 NaDFOB/NaFSI 值得关注，低温柔性由 NaFSI-E 在解决腐蚀后承担，NaPF6 并未被列为低温适用盐，故候选作为低温选择被原文否定。
- candidate-5-napf6-baseline：候选（NaPF6-E）在目标 -10 °C 条件下保持低温循环稳定的能力已由实测反证，无需补充；但若欲以 NaPF6-E 作为低温方案，需另行提供改善低温性能的配方证据（非本候选所具备）。
